name: microfrontend-learning
description: Root package — installs all apps and runs them together

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix host && npm install --prefix react-mfe-1 && npm install --prefix react-mfe-2 && npm install --prefix vue-mfe && npm install --prefix angular-mfe
scripts.start: concurrently --names "HOST,MFE1,MFE2,VUE,ANGULAR" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,green,magenta,red" "npm start --prefix host" "npm start --prefix react-mfe-1" "npm start --prefix react-mfe-2" "npm start --prefix vue-mfe" "npm start --prefix angular-mfe"
scripts.build:mfes: npm run build --prefix react-mfe-1 && npm run build --prefix react-mfe-2 && npm run build --prefix vue-mfe && npm run build --prefix angular-mfe
scripts.copy:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/react-mfe-1 dist/react-mfe-2 dist/vue-mfe dist/angular-mfe && cp -r react-mfe-1/dist/. dist/react-mfe-1/ && cp -r react-mfe-2/dist/. dist/react-mfe-2/ && cp -r vue-mfe/dist/. dist/vue-mfe/ && cp -r angular-mfe/dist/angular-mfe/. dist/angular-mfe/ && cp -r host/dist/. dist/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:mfes && npm run build:host && npm run copy:dist
